from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,math
sys.path.insert(0,'C:/Users/dfred/AppData/Local/Temp/s169af-arb')
from flint import arb,ctx
ctx.prec=256
root=Path('C:/Users/dfred/Desktop/Projects/IGH/quantyra-wormhole-semiclassical')
prior=json.loads((root/'evidence/current-coupled-local-graph-bound.json').read_bytes())['runs'][-1]['result']
def dec(v):
 d=v['decimal_enclosure'];return arb(int(d['mid']),int(d['rad']))*arb(10)**int(d['exponent'])
def enc(v):return str(v)
comb=math.comb
c=[arb(0) for _ in range(22)];c[0]=arb(1)
for k in range(11):c[11+k]=-arb(math.factorial(21)//math.factorial(10)**2)*(-1)**k*comb(10,k)/(11+k)
log2=arb(2).log();cells=512;cuts={};jets=[]
for cell in range(cells):
 mid=arb(2*cell+1)/(2*cells);rad=arb(1)/(2*cells)
 coeff=[sum((c[k]*comb(k,j)*mid**(k-j) for k in range(j,22)),arb(0)) for j in range(22)]
 jet=[]
 for j in range(4):
  cen=coeff[j]*math.factorial(j)
  err=sum((abs(coeff[k])*math.factorial(k)//math.factorial(k-j)*rad**(k-j) for k in range(j+1,22)),arb(0)) if False else sum((abs(coeff[k])*arb(math.factorial(k)//math.factorial(k-j))*rad**(k-j) for k in range(j+1,22)),arb(0))
  jet.append(cen+arb(0,err.abs_upper()))
 jets.append(jet)
for p in range(2,13):
 sup=[arb(p)**j*arb('.5')**p for j in range(4)]
 integ=[sup[j]**2/(2*p) for j in range(4)]
 for i,jet in enumerate(jets):
  exp=(p*log2*(arb(i+1)/cells-1)).exp()
  for j in range(4):
   rr=sum((comb(j,l)*arb(p)**(j-l)*jet[l]/log2**l for l in range(j+1)),arb(0))
   bound=(exp*rr.abs_upper()).abs_upper()
   sup[j]=max(sup[j],bound)
   integ[j]+=log2/cells*bound**2
 cuts[p]=[sum((comb(3,j)*sup[j] for j in range(4)),arb(0)),sum((comb(3,j)*integ[j].sqrt() for j in range(4)),arb(0))]
out=[]; alternatives={}
for i in range(2):
 row=[]
 for j in range(2):
  lo=arb(0);hi=arb(0);terms=[]
  for t in prior['matrix_bounds'][i][j]['terms']:
   p=t['z_power'];oldm,oldl=[dec(v) for v in prior['cutoff_constants'][str(p)]]
   l=dec(t['low'])*10**p*cuts[p][1]/oldl
   h=dec(t['high'])*10**p*cuts[p][0]/oldm
   lo+=l;hi+=h;terms.append({'p':p,'lo':str(l),'hi':str(h)})
  row.append({'lo':lo,'hi':hi,'bound':(lo**2+hi**2).sqrt(),'terms':terms})
 out.append(row)
M=[[v['bound'] for v in row] for row in out]
rho=(M[0][0]+M[1][1]+((M[0][0]-M[1][1])**2+4*M[0][1]*M[1][0]).sqrt())/2
result={'matrix':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in M],'rho':str(rho),'rows':[str(sum(row)) for row in M], 'entries':[[{k:(str(v) if isinstance(v,arb) else v) for k,v in entry.items()} for entry in row] for row in out]}
for removed in [(3,), (3,4)]:
 mat=[]
 for i in range(2):
  rr=[]
  for j in range(2):
   lo=arb(0);hi=arb(0)
   for t in prior['matrix_bounds'][i][j]['terms']:
    p=t['z_power']
    if p in removed:continue
    oldm,oldl=[dec(v) for v in prior['cutoff_constants'][str(p)]]
    lo+=dec(t['low'])*10**p*cuts[p][1]/oldl
    hi+=dec(t['high'])*10**p*cuts[p][0]/oldm
   rr.append((lo**2+hi**2).sqrt())
  mat.append(rr)
 alternatives[str(removed)]={'matrix':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in mat], 'max_row':str(max(sum(row) for row in mat))}
result['alternatives']=alternatives
Path(__file__).with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='entries'},indent=2))
